mentions.name: Schedyou
mentions.description: A simple, single-person, self-hostable scheduling app similar to Calendly or Cal.com, designed as a lightweight replacement for a self-hosted Cal.com instance. It is also being built as an experiment in using AI tools to develop a maintainable project of medium complexity, decomposed into a few dozen tasks with manual code review.
mentions.problem: Self-hosted Cal.com is way overkill for a single person's scheduling needs and annoying to maintain.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a simple, single person, self-hostable scheduling app [1] (think Calendly or Cal.com) to replace my self-hosted Cal.com instance, as it's way overkill for my needs and annoying to maintain.
